title: Renvoy: one CI/CD definition, native pipelines for every provider
description: Renvoy compiles one provider-neutral CI/CD definition (renvoy.yaml) into native pipeline files for GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps Pipelines, Jenkins Declarative Pipeline, and Atlassian Bamboo (YAML and Java Specs). Each provider declares a capability matrix, so anything a provider cannot express is reported as a located error instead of being dropped, and generated files carry checksums so hand edits are never silently overwritten. Apache-2.0; see https://github.com/amitpatole/renvoy
